description: Look up historical contract awards across CanadaBuys open data and Alberta Purchasing Connection to see who won a buyer's past similar tenders, disclosed award values (min/median/max CAD), repeat-winner incumbent concentration, and APC interested-supplier counts. Pass a live tender `reference` to auto-match its buyer and scope, or search by `buyer`, `keywords`, `unspsc`, `supplier`, or `province`. No LLM call. Historical awards inform pricing and incumbent risk; they do not predict future bids or guarantee eligibility. Hosted: sign-in required; includes 2 free tender review credits, then a workspaceAlberta Bid Pack or Pro subscription.

buyer.description: Buyer or contracting entity name (e.g. 'Public Services and Procurement Canada', 'Alberta Transportation')

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

limit.description: Maximum comparable awards to return (default 15, max 40)

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

reference.description: Optional live CanadaBuys or Alberta APC reference number to auto-resolve buyer, UNSPSC, and keywords

supplier.description: Optional winning supplier / competitor name to inspect

name: get_buyer_award_history
title: Check historical contract awards
